arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Charles Reischel argued the issue is fundamental to the civil jury system.
He noted courts of appeals have disagreed for decades.
Mr. Emig referenced the standard for granting a new trial.
He cited the Honda Motor case as a suggestion for the standard.
